topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I was in my classroom, the last rays of the day slipping through the windows, casting long shadows across the room. Everything was quiet, almost too quiet. Suddenly, a knock at the door startled me. It was a small package, left with the school secretary and marked with my name. No return address. I couldn't help but hesitate, my hands trembling slightly as I tore at the rough brown paper. Inside, a beautifully crafted book, pages filled with memories and notes from my former students. Each page turned slowly, revealing a world of past lessons and moments, some I had almost forgotten. The room grew colder, the shadows darker, as I realized how much these words meant, how deeply they cut through the silence of my thoughts.
